tickets.title: Raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer $3,500-to-$4,200 next cycle
tickets.text: Increase the monthly transfer from Velvet Acorn Custody to Teacup Comet Bank checking to $3,500–$4,200 for the next cycle, based on Liora Pebblefizz’s utilities and home-maintenance cash needs.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-07-24 to raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer $3,500-to-$4,200 next cycle.
